description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/central_D1_dirichlet_bc driven by problems/advection_1d_dirichlet_central.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — no per-resolution fixture files. The rule is exercised as the advective term of a well-posed advection-diffusion decay problem (a two-sided fixed-value gradient reflects at an outflow wall in pure advection, so the physical diffusion supplies the boundary dissipation that makes it well posed; derivation in the problem file). The exact unforced solution u*(x,t) = e^{2x} + e^{-lambda t} e^{x} sin(pi x) (nonzero fixed-value walls gL=1, gR=e^2) decays parabolically, so the recorded L2/Linf errors at t=0.05 are the clean O(dx^2) spatial truncation of the 2nd-order centered interior plus mirror-ghost fixed-value faces, dominated by the advective closure under test.
